scope: Seven remaining root Flutter test/showcase EPUB owners; fixed local-calendar ZIP entry time. Existing caller interfaces and payload construction retained.
cause: ZIP entry metadata contributes to the original-file digest, which participates in the publication identity. Lazy clock defaults can make independent builds of identical content look like replacement publications.

priorCauseProof.limit: Controlled reproduction of the exact restart assertion after a successful save, not reconstruction of the historical schedules.

red.expectedFailures: All seven time-stability tests. Entries match in payload/order; raw original-file digests differ.

green.meaning: All seven stability tests and all seven changed-content tests pass; independent default-clock positive control still detects the two-second difference.

controlledProof.method: Private copy of the pinned archive package accepts a Zone-scoped default time. No shared dependency changes, fixture cache, waits, clock-boundary sampling, production mutation or general mutation campaign. Each actual builder runs independently at local 2026-01-01 noon and noon plus two seconds. Changed-content pairs use the same clock to isolate content sensitivity.
controlledProof.payloadPreservation: All seven observation pairs have identical entry payload hashes and order across red and green. For pages.book these are admitted text entries plus raw archive digest; its untouched payload-building source supplies the raw-construction evidence.
controlledProof.restoration: restoration.json; diagnostic/reproduction.txt; compressed test, dependency patch and per-command patches

design: Each existing fixture owner sets new entry times. The CSS rewrite fixes replacements only. The two pre-existing encoder overrides stay at their original date to preserve named corpus identities. No generic builder layer or caller option was added.
audit: inventory.json; source-inventory.txt; caller-audit.json. Additional isolated research creators are recorded in td-bz4y, outside the settled seven-owner implementation scope.
preservation: preserved.json confirms the complete lib tree, original restart test, earlier fixed helpers, fixture assets, dependencies and web sources remain unchanged.
checks: commands.jsonl contains complete exact commands, exit statuses, source snapshots and compressed log hashes. test-results.json records each executed test-suite result and every skip reason or existing boolean gate.
failures: Seven expected diagnostic failures, a corrected rg inventory-helper error, and a corrected tk-generated ticket EOF blank line. Both development issues are recorded in development-failures.json. No final test failures.
limits: Optional downloaded-corpus and opt-in benchmark checks retain their existing skip gates; no network download or benchmark override is claimed.
